quote: The unicity conjecture, as remarked by Frobenius in 1913, states that for a given Markov number c, there is exactly one normalized solution having c as its largest element.
note: Frobenius is cited as having 'remarked' on this conjecture in his 1913 paper 'Über die Markoffschen Zahlen'. The Wikipedia article attributes this remark to Frobenius but does not identify an earlier original proposer.
